n7fa3bb72c4.headline: The cost of the corona crisis to the Estonian economy last year is at least 1.57 billion euros
n7fa3bb72c4.summary: The corona crisis cost the Estonian economy at least 1.57 billion euros in 2020, with 20.8 million working hours lost, according to a Development Monitoring Centre expert.
n7fa3bb72c4.why: Estonia's economic contraction due to the pandemic highlights the impact of COVID-19 on small open economies in Europe and labor market disruptions.
